proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + stored_spell_grant family
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord (types.ts only defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord). The taxonomy lists magic_item_root but the surface has no corresponding record type or payload family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: export type UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord; — magic_item is absent

proposed_widenings.name: fixed_dc override on stored spell grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The potion specifies a hardcoded save DC 13, independent of any caster's spell save DC. Existing DcSource only has caster_spell_save_dc and weapon_attack_dc. A stored spell grant needs a fixed_dc variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast the level 3 version of the Animal Friendship spell (save DC 13)

proposed_widenings.name: consume_item activation + stored_spell payload
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items that grant spell access via consumption (drinking) need an activation model: consume the item (charge/item destroyed) → cast stored spell at fixed level. No existing family covers item-consumption-as-activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the Animal Friendship spell

notes: The blocking gap is structural: magic_item is not in UnitRecord at all. Secondary gaps (fixed DC override, consume-item activation, stored spell level lock) would also need surface widening once the kind exists. The v4 taxonomy already has magic_item_root and charge atoms, so the atom inventory is not the problem — the surface type layer is missing.
